summary.description: One sentence naming what the author asked for and how many other locations it reaches.

targets.description: Every other manuscript location the author's comment reaches. Return [] when the commented passage is the only affected location.

path.description: Repository-relative path of a .tex file under the configured manuscript source root.

selectedText.description: Exact, uniquely occurring source text at the affected location. Anchor the smallest span that fully contains what must change.

comment.description: The review comment to place at this location, written as an instruction to the author, in the author's own terms.

reason.description: Why the author's original comment reaches this location.
